overview: The Medford City Council voted to reconsider and adopt Plan A for city re-precincting, approved the order for the November 2021 municipal election, and called for urgent repairs and a site meeting regarding sidewalk safety on Brooks Street.

items.title: Paper 21-590 Withdrawal
items.summary: Vice President Adam Knight withdrew paper 21-590.

items.title: Reconsideration of Re-Precincting Plan
items.summary: Approved a motion for reconsideration of paper 21-551 and subsequently voted to adopt Plan A for ward and precinct redistricting.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Asian Taste
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license petition for Barry Lee, LLC, doing business as Asian Taste at 207 Middlesex Avenue.

items.title: Fellsway West Crossing Guard Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city administration hire a crossing guard on Fellsway West for Roberts Elementary School students.

items.title: Brooks Street Sidewalk and Traffic Safety
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting immediate emergency DPW repairs and an on-site meeting with municipal department heads regarding sidewalk deterioration and traffic hazards on Brooks Street.

items.title: Parks Commission Involvement in Carr Park Revitalization
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking that the Parks Commission be invited to attend all future Carr Park revitalization meetings.

items.title: Removal of Construction Equipment on Prescott Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that Newport Construction immediately remove a trailer and backhoe equipment blocking the sidewalk at Prescott and Alston Streets.

items.title: Order for 2021 Municipal Election
items.summary: Approved the order calling the November 2, 2021 municipal election and designating polling places, as amended to request a citywide robocall regarding voter polling locations.

items.title: Ordinance Amendment on Position Salary Caps
items.summary: Passed paper 21-548 on its third reading to amend revised ordinances concerning municipal position salary caps.

items.title: Public Participation on Veteran Services
items.summary: Resident Edward F. Linehan spoke to thank the administration for reinstating Veteran Services Officer Michael Durham.

items.title: Early Voting Announcement and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Announced the early voting schedule for the municipal election and voted to table the meeting records from October 12, 2021.
